findings.text: The brief's deliverable 3 is a walk report (pass/fix per step, ms to first reply, bubble order, phone vs desktop text, shots) at this path, and `doc/chat.md`, `doc/next.md` and `doc/surfaces.md` all link here for it. The dir holds only requirements.md, task.jsonl and review/diff.patch, so those links resolved to nothing until this reviewer file appeared. The numbers quoted in `next.md` (2.6 s, 23.6 s, 11.4 s, 6.2 s, $0.38-0.48) and the shots have no evidence file the reader can open; the walk's shots and its script must be committed here and the report written, or the links point at a stand-in that holds no walk.

The walk covers New session, the sheet title and the mic-message wrap, but `next.md` item 1 (fast agent replies when not addressed) is left open with only a prose recommendation. The brief says a needed Servex change is a `decision` line with the exact edit; the diff has the file and the intent (`Servex/agents/session-fast.md`) but not the edit text, and no `decision` line is visible in this diff.

`ext/drawer/rail.js:583-588`: `DrawerRailSheetChat.head()` builds the New button inside `$head.append(() => ...)` and then moves it with `insertBefore` relative to `.drawer-rail-sheet-more`. That works only if `super.head()` has already added More. A direct `$head.append` after `super.head()` would be simpler, and a `new_in_head` prototype flag plus a head override is two mechanisms for one move.

`ext/drawer/rail.css:295-298`: the New-session rules `.drawer-rail-sheet-new` rely on that class existing on the button from `new_session_button()`. Confirm in a shot at 400 that in the full state, with More hidden, New still sits right (no shot is in the task dir to check).

`ux/Dictate/chat.js:96,118`: `fresh` lives in `sessionStorage` as `{fresh:true}`, so `read_saved()` now returns an object with no `session`. Any other reader of that key (the push-to-talk or devshell code) that tests only that the value is truthy would treat it as a saved session. Worth one grep.

`ux/Dictate/chat.js:173`: the echo guard now re-draws a line whose `at` is in `own_ats` when the thread lacks it. It is a sound fix for the vanishing first sentence, but it has no test or proof script in the diff; add the replay check to the task dir.
`Chat.css` and `rail.css` changes are small and layer-correct. The `!important` hides in rail.css follow the existing pattern right above them.
